classification_policy.complete_meaning: Ordinary software-completable implementation and repository integration are present; live semantic/provider/hardware/production acceptance is not implied.
classification_policy.external_blocked_meaning: The repository-side contract/integration is implemented and the remaining gate requires a provider, credential, host, device, hardware driver, target environment, or human/live acceptance evidence.

required_acceptance: select and configure a real embedding provider/model with stable identity and dimensions
provide required provider credentials/runtime
run retrieval-quality evaluation against retained corpus evidence
leave semantic_quality_verified false until acceptance passes
use the credentialed approved host without changing benchmark prompts or validators
run provider/tool/stream regression and the unchanged live-agent benchmark
retain per-task responses and independent validator evidence
do not upgrade competence from the historical 3/12 validated baseline without new evidence
provide credentials for an explicitly enabled secondary provider
run provider regression and retain runtime evidence
run on an approved networked host against allowlisted public HTTPS destinations
verify private/reserved-address and DNS-rebinding rejection
verify TLS hostname validation, redirect revalidation and output/body limits
retain evidence before changing live_browser_verified
provide a concrete ComputerAdapter through SparkleSystem
grant only required OS display/accessibility/input permissions
verify screenshots, click, type and key operations inside an approved session
retain action evidence and keep unapproved actions fail-closed
provide concrete SpeechToText and TextToSpeech adapters through SparkleSystem
configure provider/device credentials and microphone/speaker permissions as applicable
run bounded transcription and synthesis acceptance with retained evidence
do not change live_stt_verified or live_tts_verified from adapter existence alone
select/configure a provider model that explicitly supports the requested audio/document modality
supply a provider adapter mapping that modality without text flattening
run live modality acceptance and retain provider evidence
provide a hardware-specific MotionAdapter through SparkleSystem
configure device transport and permissions
run only explicitly approved capabilities/commands
retain physical-device evidence before changing live_motion_verified
provision the approved hardened Linux worker host
configure TLS/HMAC secret material and the expected worker identity
verify isolation and signed request/response behavior
execute an approved immutable artifact through the documented Level-3 acceptance workflow
keep Level 3 PARKED until all host evidence passes
run the unchanged scripted/live task definitions on the credentialed host
do not weaken validators, hard-code answers or special-case prompts
retain failure/inconclusive cases and per-task evidence
evaluate generated application/agent/research/learning quality separately from software existence
provide an embedded Python/application host on each target mobile platform
grant required storage/network/device permissions
verify native state layout, startup, API/dashboard client and supported browser/voice adapter paths
do not represent the Linux external worker as a native mobile worker
obtain explicit user deployment authorization
configure the target environment and credentials
satisfy applicable Level-3 prerequisites
run a separate production deployment acceptance milestone
keep deployment FROZEN until explicitly authorized

notes: Dedicated data/content/research/interaction/voice CLIs and bounded agent tools are retained instead of adding redundant mutation APIs.
GET /api/health exposes vector, platform, voice, interaction, data-analysis, content, research, automation and other subsystem status through SparkleSystem.status().
Browser network authority and computer actions remain operator-owned session boundaries rather than unrestricted agent tools.
Level 3 is PARKED and deployment is FROZEN.
